title: Path With Minimum Effort
description: Find a path from (0,0) to (rows-1, cols-1) that minimizes the maximum absolute difference in heights between adjacent cells.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize efforts matrix with infinity, set (0,0) to 0
2. Use a min-priority queue to store [effort, r, c]
3. While queue is not empty:
4. Pop [effort, r, c] with minimum effort
5. If (r,c) is target, return effort
6. For each neighbor (nr, nc):
7. NewEffort = max(effort, abs(grid[r][c] - grid[nr][nc]))
8. If NewEffort < efforts[nr][nc]: update efforts, push to queue

steps.note: Initialize effort matrix with infinity, start at (0,0)
Evaluate neighbor (0, 1): diff is |2-1| = 1. New effort is 1.
Evaluate neighbor (1, 0): diff is |3-1| = 2. New effort is 2.
Evaluate neighbor (1, 1) from (0, 1): diff is |4-2| = 2. Effort is max(1, 2) = 2.
